topic: missing await on async function call causing flaky test assertions
question: Quick reminder — what was the actual root cause?
butterfly_answer: The test called `createUser` without `await`, so the assertion ran before the async operation resolved — `name` was still `undefined` at the time of the check.
lastN_answer: The prior context doesn't mention a root cause. The conversation was focused on code style cleanup (const/let, error message casing, import order, function length) — no bug or root cause was discussed.
needle_fact: The test in user.service.test.ts called the async method svc.createUser({ name: 'alice' }) without await, so the INSERT and the this.cache.latest = input assignment happened on a later microtask, after svc.getLatest() had already read the stale undefined value.
